title: King leads solemn Remembrance Sunday service at Cenotaph
description: Wreaths are laid as 10,000 armed forces veterans, including 12 from World War Two, pay tribute in central London.

title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
description: It is yet unclear what caused the accident but Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said an investigation is underway and will "hold accountable anyone who proves their negligence".

title: 'Time is up': Minister warns media industry to take abuse seriously in wake of Brand case
description: Lisa Nandy tells the BBC "many people" in the media industry have come forward to her.

title: Nandy defends linking Erasmus student scheme to Remembrance Sunday after backlash
description: The culture secretary says the UK rejoining the EU's study and work scheme will help honour wartime sacrifice.

title: My parents chose to die together and I was left to grieve alone
description: Els and Jan sought medical intervention to end their lives after 50 happy years of marriage, leaving behind their only child.

title: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now?
description: Republicans can stick with Trumpism or chart a new path, writes BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush.

title: He spent $50,000 on Labubus but now the craze is dying
description: Parent company Pop Mart's revenue has fallen as appetite for the quirky collectible monsters wanes.

title: Ambika Mod wants to change how South Asian women are seen on-screen
description: The actress joins the cast of Black Doves for the second season of Netflix's spy thriller.

title: Can the Zelda remake capture the magic of the original?
description: Nintendo has released its remake of what is considered one of the best games ever made - the BBC's Tom Gerken gives his verdict.
